map_info.name: Facade_Baroque
map_info.description: The dramatized expression of facade assembly. The principle's six moves all applied, but with theatrical excess — syncopated bay rhythm, broken pediments, paired columns clustering, projecting and recessing surfaces, rustication interrupted by smooth carving. The rule held; the application turned up to maximum semantic intensity.

learning_objectives: Recognise the principle applied with theatrical intensity
Read syncopation as a rhythm that breaks the regular beat without breaking the rule
Identify projecting/recessing surface play as a baroque-specific axis

map_info.title: The Principle Dramatized

sp.name: Spawn
sp.description: Player spawn point — back-centre, facing the dramatized facade

documentation.summary: Facade_Baroque — the principle dramatized. Syncopated bays, broken pediments, projecting central pavilion. Bernini-style energy applied to the canonical grammar.
documentation.layout: 11x6 walkable space (slightly wider than Classical to give the syncopated bay rhythm room to read). Spawn at back-centre. Teleporter on side.
documentation.objective: Show what the principle does when every axis is pushed to its highest semantic intensity — rhythm syncopated, ornament dense, hierarchy emphasised through projecting volumes.
key_elements: Facade with projecting central bay (artifacts queued for pass-3 artifact build)
